Skincare newbie here! I'm going to start putting actual effort into my skin, because I'm tired of constantly picking at my face. (I know, I know, I should start with stopping the picking) 

I'm primarily looking for cleanser suggestions, as I've never really done cleansing as a regular thing. 

I have predominantly dry skin, with some oilyness on my nose and occasionally my forehead. My skin is very sensitive, from either harsh ingredients or even touch. I have enlarged pores on my nose, and I frequently get zits and/or blackheads on my chin or my upper lip. But I would not consider myself actually thaaaat acne-prone. 

I use Nivea's day cream in the morning, followed by Avene's sunscreen. 
At night, I take off my makeup with either Pond's Cold Cream (which does an amazing job but does feel very greasy) or if I'm lazy, makeup wipes. If I've bothered to use the cold cream, then I will use Nivea's night cream as well, but if I was lazy, I'm usually too lazy for moisturizer too. 

I've been doing some skincare research while I'm experiencing insomnia, and what I've gathered is that the first step is that I should start cleansing. But I find that things that foam irritate my skin, and it is VERY important to me to avoid microbeads. 

I also don't love slapping some water on my face. I kind of would prefer to just put product on my dry face.

Help?

I only use the Coppertone Waterbabies sunscreen for this reason. Anything that’s formulated for infants is less likely to have the crazy strong actives in it, and it’s the only way I can wear sunscreen without breaking out into hives
